title: Blink timer wraps around
prompt: A blinking light keeps a timer t that grows by delta each frame and wraps back to zero every period seconds. Return the new t after adding delta and wrapping.
signature: func solve(t: float, delta: float, period: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(t: float, delta: float, period: float) -> float:
	return t + delta
hint: fmod() is the remainder for decimals: fmod(1.1, 1.0) is 0.1. Add first, then take the remainder.
solution:
func solve(t: float, delta: float, period: float) -> float:
	return fmod(t + delta, period)
